name: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS)
limitations: Heterogeneous PDS3/PDS4 formats; discovery requires node-specific search

name: LRO LOLA polar gridded DEM LDEM_80S_80M
crs: Polar stereographic on 1737.4 km sphere (Moon, IAU_2015:30100 sphere)
variables: topography (height above 1737.4 km sphere; DN*0.5 m)
limitations: Interpolated between LOLA tracks; local artefacts near pole; 80 m smooths rover-scale hazards

name: LRO LOLA global LDEM 118 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic)
limitations: Equirectangular distortion at high latitude (polar references use DS-LOLA-80S instead)

name: MGS MOLA global DEM 463 m (USGS Astrogeology mosaic)
limitations: 463 m posting cannot resolve rover-scale slopes; polar interpolation

name: NASA Moon Trek
limitations: Portal/WMTS; programmatic bulk use requires per-layer API endpoints

name: NASA Mars Trek
limitations: Portal; layers are derived products — cite originals

name: LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer Experiment
variables: surface brightness temperature, thermal inertia, rock abundance
limitations: Only literature temperature values used here (Paige 2010; Horvath 2022 via NASA release); gridded products not downloaded

name: LCROSS mission (NSSDCA catalog entry)
variables: water detected in ejecta (5.6±2.9 wt%, Colaprete et al. 2010)
limitations: Single impact sample of one PSR; not representative of all cold traps

name: LRO Camera (LROC) incl. Lunar Pits Atlas
limitations: Atlas depths from stereo models (data warning in atlas)

name: MRO HiRISE
limitations: Not downloaded: very large products; targeted coverage only

name: MRO Context Camera (CTX)
limitations: Not downloaded in this build

name: MRO CRISM
variables: VNIR-SWIR spectra, mineral indices (clays, sulfates, carbonates)
limitations: Literature mineralogy (Jezero clays/carbonates, Gale clays/sulfates) used via cited text only

name: Mars Odyssey THEMIS
variables: thermal IR, thermal inertia; cave-skylight detections
limitations: Used only via Cushing et al. 2007 skylight literature

name: USGS Astrogeology Science Center
limitations: Mosaics re-gridded from original PDS data

name: ESA Planetary Science Archive
limitations: Not downloaded in this build

name: NASA Earthdata / EOSDIS
license_access: free; Earthdata Login required for download
limitations: No Earthdata credentials in build environment; see scripts/retrieve_credentialed_or_blocked.py

name: MODIS Terra LST/Emissivity 8-day MOD11A2 v061
limitations: Not retrieved (credentials); script provided via AppEEARS API

name: AppEEARS point/area extraction service
limitations: Requires token

name: USGS EarthExplorer
license_access: free; USGS ERS login for download
limitations: Interactive portal; M2M API needs login

name: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 (Level-2 SR/ST)
spatial_resolution: 30 m (OLI); TIRS 100 m resampled to 30 m
license_access: public domain; open (AWS requester-pays or EarthExplorer)
limitations: Not downloaded in this build; recommended for spectral lithology indices

name: Copernicus Sentinel-2 MSI L2A
license_access: free, open (Copernicus licence); account for bulk API
limitations: Not downloaded in this build

name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (COG on AWS Open Data)
license_access: Copernicus DEM licence (free, attribution); open https
limitations: DSM (includes vegetation/buildings); flattened over water; voids/edits in steep terrain

name: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200 (AWS)
limitations: Classification accuracy ~77% overall (product validation); bare vs sparse vegetation confusion in drylands

name: ERA5 hourly single levels (Copernicus CDS)
license_access: Copernicus licence; free CDS account + API key
variables: 2 m temperature, precipitation, radiation, wind, soil temp
limitations: Accessed through Open-Meteo (DS-ERA5-OM) instead of CDS; reanalysis biases in complex terrain/polar areas

name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (ERA5)
license_access: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); ERA5 Copernicus licence; open, no key
variables: daily Tmean/Tmax/Tmin, precipitation, FAO-56 ET0, wind, shortwave
limitations: Nearest grid cell; grid elevation differs from site elevation (recorded in site_evidence.json)

name: OpenTopography
license_access: free; API key for global DEM API
limitations: Copernicus DEM retrieved directly from AWS instead

name: WorldClim 2.1 historical climate (1970-2000)
limitations: geodata.ucdavis.edu download host refused TLS from build host on 2026-11-15 (curl error 35); CHELSA V2.1 used instead; script provided

name: CHELSA V2.1 climatologies 1981-2010
variables: bio1 MAAT, bio5, bio6, bio7, bio12
limitations: Downscaled model; uncertain in data-sparse polar/high-mountain areas

name: Obu et al. NH permafrost probability 2000-2016 (ESA GlobPermafrost)
limitations: Modelled (TTOP); RMS 2.0 °C vs boreholes; no Southern Hemisphere

name: ESA CCI Permafrost (Climate Change Initiative)
coverage: Northern Hemisphere (+Antarctic products in later versions)
variables: ground temperature, permafrost fraction, active layer thickness
limitations: Not downloaded; Obu et al. used (same TTOP lineage)

name: Macrostrat geologic map API
limitations: Small-scale global maps generalise lithology; coverage gaps

name: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0 (REST API)
coverage: Earth global land (bare rock/ice often masked)
license_access: CC BY 4.0; open API (fair-use rate limit)
limitations: Machine-learning predictions with large uncertainty in deserts/polar areas

name: OpenStreetMap via Overpass API
limitations: Mapping completeness varies; tracks under-mapped in remote areas

name: Natural Earth 1:110m land
limitations: Cartographic only

name: Wikipedia (English) GeoData + article extracts
variables: site coordinates; keyword evidence for categorical tags
limitations: Tertiary source; used for coordinates and qualitative tags only, with revision IDs recorded
